mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that accelerate corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0% in 3 months, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% MoM indicates robust consumer and business confidence, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: When RSAFS and HOUST both rise >0.5% MoM, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 in 3 months signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days specifically during late-cycle economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle slowdowns, INDPRO declines >2.0% in 3 months do not produce negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% YoY triggers expectations of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% YoY, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Consistent monthly job growth above 100k (PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without conditional thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k per month.

mechanism_narrative: In strong GDP growth phases (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), rising housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% MoM signal housing sector strength that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In GDPC1 growth >2.0% annualized periods, rising HOUST >0.5% MoM does not generate positive 20-day S&P 500 returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rise above 5.1% signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines >1.0% MoM and UNRATE rises >0.2pp MoM, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
